title: PG-05.1 Engine integration: merge semantics, mapping, boundary (memev)
request: Programme contract for work package WP05 in memev: Engine integration: merge semantics, mapping, boundary. Proposed and unsigned; the signer (ASTL workstream) signs it after the red-team gate. Source: the programme decomposition of 31 Oct 2026 (docs/scope-one/programme/WBS.md, docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md, docs/scope-one/programme/fragments/WP05.json) and the owner notes behind docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md.
